\begin{aligned}
a(0) &= 0 \\
a(2n) &= a(n) \\

\end{aligned}

- **Base case**: $ a(0) = 0 $
- **Even indices**: $ a(2n) = a(n) $ — the value at an even index is the same as the value at half that index.
- **Odd indices**: $ a(2n+1) = 1 - a(n) $ — the value at an odd index is the opposite of the value at half the index (rounded down).

This recurrence is **non-linear** and **non-homogeneous**, but it is **deterministic** and **efficient** for generating the sequence.
